title: Attachment Single or 2-Way Change Solenoid Short Circuit
detail_of_failure: The pump controller senses a ground fault in the attachment single or 2-way change solenoid circuit.
controller_action: • Stops to drive the attachment single or 2-way change solenoid. • After the cause of the failure is removed, the machine does not become normal until the starting switch is turned to the OFF position once.
machine_effect: The hydraulic circuit for attachment does not become a single-acting circuit.
related_information: Monitoring code The command (ON or OFF) from the controller to the attachment single or 2-way change solenoid can be monitored. (As long as the command from the controller is ON, the indication on the monitor is ON even if the solenoid is not energized because there is an open circuit.) (Code: 02301)

steps.procedure: 1. Check the wiring harnesses and connectors. REMARK For details of checking method, see “RELATED INFORMATION TO TROUBLESHOOT”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”. 2. Are the wiring harnesses and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harnesses and connectors are normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • A wiring harness or connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.
